description: Provision a Google Cloud Compute ComputeTargetInstance via Config Connector. Fields mirror the compute.cnrm.cloud.google.com/v1beta1 ComputeTargetInstance spec.

description.description: Immutable. An optional description of this resource.

instanceRef.description: The ComputeInstance handling traffic for this target instance. Set exactly one of `external` (the resource's GCP URI or ID) or `name` (plus optional `namespace`) referencing another Config Connector resource in the cluster.

external.description: A reference to an externally managed ComputeInstance resource. Should be in the format "projects/{{projectID}}/zones/{{zone}}/instances/{{instanceID}}".

name.description: The name of a ComputeInstance resource.

namespace.description: The namespace of a ComputeInstance resource.

natPolicy.description: Immutable. NAT option controlling how IPs are NAT'ed to the instance. Currently only NO_NAT (default value) is supported. Default value: "NO_NAT" Possible values: ["NO_NAT"].

networkRef.description: The network this target instance uses to forward traffic. If not specified, the traffic will be forwarded to the network that the default network interface belongs to. Set exactly one of `external` (the resource's GCP URI or ID) or `name` (plus optional `namespace`) referencing another Config Connector resource in the cluster.

external.description: A reference to an externally managed ComputeNetwork resource. Should be in the format "projects/{{projectID}}/global/networks/{{networkID}}".

name.description: The name of a ComputeNetwork resource.

namespace.description: The namespace of a ComputeNetwork resource.

projectId.description: GCP project ID for this resource. Rendered as the cnrm.cloud.google.com/project-id annotation. Leave empty to inherit the project from the namespace (Config Connector falls back to the namespace's project-id annotation, then to the namespace name). Leave empty when this resource's spec already carries a projectRef.
projectId.title: GCP project ID

resourceID.description: Immutable. Optional. The name of the resource. Used for creation and acquisition. When unset, the value of `metadata.name` is used as the default.

securityPolicyRef.description: The resource URL for the security policy associated with this target instance. Set exactly one of `external` (the resource's GCP URI or ID) or `name` (plus optional `namespace`) referencing another Config Connector resource in the cluster.

external.description: A reference to an externally managed ComputeSecurityPolicy resource. Should be in the format "projects/{{projectID}}/global/securityPolicies/{{name}}".

name.description: The name of a ComputeSecurityPolicy resource.

namespace.description: The namespace of a ComputeSecurityPolicy resource.

zone.description: Immutable. URL of the zone where the target instance resides.

title: GCP Compute ComputeTargetInstance
